title: A playlist dataclass
hints: Add a `tracks: list[int]` field. A plain `= []` default is refused by `@dataclass` (it would be shared), so use `field(default_factory=list)`.
`add` is just `self.tracks.append(seconds)`. For the label, `minutes, secs = divmod(sum(self.tracks), 60)`.
`tracks: list[int] = field(default_factory=list)` and `return f"{minutes}:{secs:02d}"`. Zero-padding with `:02d` turns `5` into `"05"`.
